profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer at Microsoft | Dotnet and React Developer
profile.summary:
A software engineer that has a passion for teaching and teamwork.

As a lawyer I enjoyed solving problems for my clients. But it was not enough for me, so I became a software developer to solve large-scale problems for millions of people.

Being a software engineer and a lawyer have similarities, they solve real-life problems that people have. My time as a lawyer was not lost time, I learned about the legal system and acquired soft skills that will allow me to deal with all kinds of people and have more empathy.

✉ steve.silverio.cruz@gmail.com

Skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, React, Redux, CSS, HTML, SQL, PostgreSQL, AWS, TDD, Jest, Algorithms & Data Structures, Git, GitHub, Docker.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented scalable features for Dynamics 365, leveraging C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, and Azure microservices.
- Reduced SQL table size by 90% by migrating lengthy Knowledge Article content column from Dataverse to Azure Storage Blobs, scaling support for 1.13M+ articles and preventing exponential database growth.
- Enhanced Microsoft support workflows with PACs Service, a new ingestion pipeline that integrates Knowledge Articles from docs.microsoft.com and internal platforms into DfM, improving support engineer efficiency and enabling AI-driven insights for a sister team's Copilot AI suggestions.
- Enabled full-stack observability by implementing a modern OpenTelemetry logging system, improving debugging time for support escalations by 30% and integrating logs into Geneva dashboards for better monitoring and alerting.
- Enhanced security and compliance by implementing privileged operation audit logging, ensuring traceability of sensitive actions, detecting unauthorized access attempts, and mitigating risks posed by foreign state actors targeting Microsoft systems. Strengthened regulatory compliance and internal security posture against sophisticated cyber threats.
- Resolved flaky Selenium-based UI tests and reduced average test execution time from 4:37 to 3:56 (15% improvement), resulting in faster test runs in the production deployment pipeline and enhanced local development efficiency for developers.
- Drove early AI adoption by integrating Merlin Bot AI suggestions into Entitlement Service Pull Requests, enhancing code reviews and improving code quality through AI-driven recommendations.
- Saved six figures per year in Azure resource costs by optimizing Bicep templates to use lower-cost tiers for test environments while keeping higher tiers for production.
- Mentored junior engineers on best practices for unit testing and code reviews, reducing pull request revisions and improving overall team efficiency and code quality.

Dynamics 365 Dynamics for Microsoft Team (DfM): CRM based on D365 Customer Service Workspace

positions.title: Lawyer
positions.description:
Partnered with fellow Lawyers to collaborate to attract clients and represent them in Civil Law cases, proactively seeking clients in my community and building credibility by giving free legal advice at local churches. 

This experience allowed me to refine several skills, such as:

- Listening to stories with an unclear sequence of events, clarifying ambiguities and filtering out irrelevant information to build a clear picture of what the client wants, while also documenting all relevant information
- Breaking down problems into a series of requirements, prioritizing tasks and deadlines (e.g. collecting evidence, investigating events) and building the final strategy in court according to the clients' needs and their reality
- Communicating clearly and concisely with clients, translating technical terms into simple words to ensure they understood all outcomes, time frames and requests for further clarification 
- Ability to work under pressure performing my job in a courtroom

positions.title: Law Intern
positions.description:
Interned at the State court of the Brazilian justice system responsible for judging first instance Civil Law cases and first appeals in the state of Minas Gerais.

By providing legal representation to people who normally can't afford access to justice, this internship helped me build a solid foundation for my soft skills such as empathy, patience, resilience and mental fortitude.

company.name: Tribunal de Justiça do Estado de Minas Gerais

positions.title: Academic Translator
positions.description: Translated scientific articles related to Law from portuguese to english.

positions.title: Programming Tutor
positions.description: Mentored incoming Computer Science freshmen from UFMG and PUC Minas without previous technical background, teaching object-oriented programming fundamentals with C++ and Java.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
Worked for a nonprofit organization that assists federal public servants that work for CEFET-MG, maintaining a PostgreSQL database with employee data and generating monthly and semiannual statistics on health insurance enrollments and cancellations.

- Fixed the company’s computers by replacing faulty hardware.
- Trained other employees on how to use the company software.
- Maintained the organization's website (built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript)

educations.schoolName: Centro Federal de Educação Tecnológica de Minas Gerais
